tagline: First Financial Bankshares, Inc. is a financial holding company that generates revenue primarily from interest on loans and investments, trust fees, and service charges on deposit accounts.
hero_kpi_rationale: Net interest margin is a key profitability indicator for banks, reflecting how efficiently they manage their interest-earning assets relative to their interest-bearing liabilities.

kpis.name: Share Repurchase
kpis.explanation: Amount of shares repurchased and retired by the company during the period.
kpis.description: No share repurchases were conducted in 2024 and 2025, although an authorization for 5 million shares remains in place until July 2026.
kpis.signal: Indicates capital return to shareholders or lack of investment opportunities.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €15.45 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.02 billion in the latest year

kpis.name: Cumulative Shareholder Performance over 5 Years
kpis.explanation: Total return to shareholders over a five-year period, including stock price appreciation and reinvested dividends.
kpis.description: Compares the company's stock performance (90.86%) to the Russell 3000 (185.47%) and S&P U.S. BMI Banks (211.47%) over a five-year period with dividend reinvestment.
kpis.signal: Measures long-term value creation for shareholders since December 2020.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.summary: The company is exposed to credit risk due to its significant lending and investment activities.
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant exposure to loans and investments, making it vulnerable to payment defaults. The allowance for credit losses to total loans ratio was 1.29% in 2025.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.summary: Fluctuations in interest rates directly affect the company's profitability and net interest margin.
risks.score_rationale: Changes in interest rates can have a significant impact on the company's results, particularly on net interest income and net interest margin.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.summary: The company must manage its cash flows to maintain liquidity and meet its obligations.
risks.score_rationale: The company must manage its cash flows to meet its obligations. A decline in liquidity could lead to financial difficulties.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.summary: The company must comply with applicable regulations to avoid penalties.
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the banking sector. Regulatory changes may impact the company's results.

risks.title: Competitive Risk
risks.summary: The company must maintain competitiveness to preserve its market share.
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market, which may lead to pressure on net interest margins and fees. Competitors may offer similar products and services.

risks.title: Asset Management Risk
risks.summary: The company must manage its assets efficiently to maintain profitability and return on average assets.
risks.score_rationale: The company must manage its assets effectively to maximize returns. Poor asset management could result in losses.

risks.title: Asset Depreciation Risk
risks.summary: The company must monitor the value of its assets and allowance for credit losses to avoid significant losses.
risks.score_rationale: The company may be exposed to losses in the event of asset depreciation, such as loans or investments.

ai_positioning.summary: FFIN does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K filing. There is no indication of AI use or integration in its operations or products.
